Initial release: AI-based real-time detection of fish gasping and abnormal respiration via aquarium cameras, providing early ammonia poisoning or hypoxia warnings.

- Monitors fish behavior for signs of hypoxia or poisoning (surface gasping, rapid mouth movement, exaggerated gill cover motion).
- Issues risk warnings when multiple fish show symptoms for over 60 seconds (configurable).
- Supports home aquariums, public displays, and aquaculture ponds with real-time alerts and 4 warning levels.
- Includes robust fish species adaptation and contextual analysis to minimize false positives.
- Enforces strict privacy and data acquisition protocols for report retrieval via open-id authentication.
- Comprehensive integration guide for use with smart aquarium systems.
